claim: The President said out loud how the 40 trillion dollar debt gets paid: inflation shrinks your dollars, not the debt, and the printing that does it is what mints the next wave of crypto billionaires, so own the things they cannot print.
why_this_claim: It is the longform's own locked hook and locked thesis line (SCREENPLAY CH1 Beat 1 and Beat 5, both SAY-EXACT) joined by the one sentence that explains the mechanism in Mike's words (the debt doesn't shrink, your dollars do) and closed by CH7's imperative (own the things they can't print). None of it needs the 1946 playbook, the bond market, Bessent, Schwab or the Fed balance sheet to land: the hook names the debt, the body names inflation as the how, the thesis names who wins, the kicker tells the viewer what to do. The TIME quote, the precedents and every receipt stay in the full video, which is what the CTA sells.

rejected.reason: The TIME quote on the C3 receipt with the yellow highlight wipe: the video's strongest receipt, but the out-gap is 0.12 s and it adds 7.4 s, which pushes any plan that also carries the mechanism and the thesis past 34 s. The hook already names the claim; the quote is the full video's pull.

'The debt is a number and that number is written in dollars.' is the cleaner way INTO the body (in_gap 0.50, the C4 ticker spinning up to its landing), but the extra 4.1 s puts hook + body + thesis at 28.6 s, over the +1 s tolerance. It is the designated FALLBACK in-point if the lint cannot find the 26.4 trough (then drop the 2.25 s kicker and run hook + 22.40-34.66 + F4 = 29.0 s, or accept 28.6 s with Mike's OK).

'And when money gets printed into a crisis, the people who already own scarce assets come out the other side, even richer.' is the ideal bridge between the body and the thesis, but its first word sits ON the F3 face-out film burn (81.47) with a 0.00 Whisper gap after 'when.', so it cannot be entered without a half-burned frame or a clipped word; and at 7.3 s it also overruns the budget.

The H5 493 count-up + F4 as one span (the 2020-2021 precedent then the bet): clean in-gap 0.58 and good variety (chart landing into face), but 11.6 s makes the total 30.3 s, and the in-point lands mid count-up (the flip counter spinning toward 493).

'And I think the number of crypto billionaires is probably going to multiply dramatically.' over card-10.4 'My bet: crypto billionaires get made next year': clean gaps (0.36 / 0.34), the thesis literally on screen, better visual variety. Passed over because the voice hedges ('probably') and never says 'next year' (only the card does), while F4 is the locked SAY-EXACT thesis line. ALTERNATIVE PLAN K for Mike: hook 0.0-10.62 + body 22.40-34.66 + this span = 27.1 s with every boundary at a 0.3 s+ gap and only one pure face span; it loses 'Own the things they can't print'.

risks: Nothing here is watched or heard: delivery energy, the vertical master's face framing on F1 / F2 / F4 / F18, and the H4 card's 9:16 layout are inferred from CUE-SHEET / EDIT-PLAN / TRANSITIONS and the FINAL-TIME transcript. The vertical lane's own QA owns the pictures.

Face-edge film burns at span boundaries are built into this video: every one of the 34 face edges is a 0.5 s hand:film-burn ON the word boundary, so a FACE span can only start inside a burn (span 3 head, 95.0) or end as one begins (span 1 tail 10.63, span 3 tail 100.90). The burn's first frames are a faint warm glow, not a half-melted picture. Mitigation: use hand:film-burn (the video's own face family) as the short's ~0.3 s seam hit so the longform's burn frames read as the seam; if any glow still shows at review, splice that seam, never re-time the audio.

Span 2 in-point (26.40): Whisper gives a 0.00 gap between 'dollars.' and 'Inflation', but 'Inflation' is stamped 1.08 s long (a 0.5 s word), i.e. it swallowed the sentence pause; the trough is expected inside 26.3-26.7. If lint-short-spans reports a mid-vowel boundary here, move the in-point to 22.40 (gap 0.50) and either drop span 4 (hook + 22.40-34.66 + F4 = 28.98 s, over by 1 s) or keep all four at 31.2 s: Mike's call, both are over his +1 s.

Span 4 out-point (780.95): Whisper gap 0.14 between 'print.' and 'And'; the +200 ms Mike asked for after 'can't print' at the spine review is already in this spine, and Whisper onsets run early, so a real trough should exist. If the lint fails it, the fallback kicker is the card-10.4 line 754.99-759.45 (gaps 0.36 / 0.34; total 29.4 s, over by 1.4 s) or no kicker (hook + body + F4 = 24.96 s, inside the code's 24-28 s window but 2 s under Mike's target).
